howto.name: Upload a WAV file
howto.text: Drop a .wav file. Uncompressed audio is the ideal source for an encode.

howto.name: PrivaTools encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: Uncompressed source gives the encoder the best possible input. At 192 kbps, expect roughly a 7:1 reduction from CD-quality WAV.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. Expect roughly a 7:1 reduction. Keep the WAV if it is your master — MP3 is a delivery format, not an archive one.

faq.a: 192 kbps, a solid default for music and speech; this page has no bitrate setting. MP3 is lossy, so a higher bitrate keeps more detail at the cost of a larger file: Audio Converter offers 256 and 320 kbps.

faq.q: How much smaller will the MP3 be?
faq.a: About 7× smaller than a CD-quality WAV, because the MP3 is encoded at 192 kbps.
FFmpeg runs on the PrivaTools server, not a third-party service. The WAV and the MP3 are temporary files that response cleanup removes after the result is sent.
